title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Programs and the Northloop Payments Payout Limit
content:
A seller's enrollment in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) scales the payout limit of the seller's Northloop Payments scheduled payouts through the fulfillment payout-limit multiplier.

**Rule.** The fulfillment payout-limit multiplier is 1.25 when the seller's FBN enrollment is active in FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program; it is 1.10 when the enrollment is active in FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program; otherwise it is 1.

## Records read

The status of the seller's FBN enrollment and the FBN program it is in, as the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment record shows them.

## Ladder

| FBN enrollment status | FBN program | Fulfillment payout-limit multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| active | FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program | 1.25 |
| active | FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program | 1.10 |
| any other case | — | 1 |

"Any other case" covers an enrollment that is not active, whatever its program, an active enrollment in another FBN program, and a seller with no FBN enrollment.

*Hypothetical cases.* An active enrollment in FBN Scale Program gives 1.10. An enrollment in FBN Premier Program that is not active gives 1. An active enrollment in FBN Core Program gives 1.
